projects.name: Honda RoadSync
projects.description: RoadSync is Honda's smart mobility solution for motorcycle ecosystems, enabling safe in-ride access to navigation, calls, music, and notifications via Bluetooth connectivity between smartphones and motorcycles while maintaining riding focus.
duties: Delivered fully localized iOS solution to Honda Japan R&D team within 6-month timeframe.
highlights: Integrated Classic Bluetooth protocols to sync instrument cluster with navigation/VoIP/music/weather data, enabling handlebar-mounted 4-way switch control with voice-guided interactions
Architected iOS app using SwiftUI+Combine with Redux pattern for state management (event-driven design)

projects.name: Tuya Smart (Smart Life & Smart Mobility Standard Edition)
projects.description: Tuya provides white-label OEM app development and management services. Based on official templates, the OEM apps offer easy UI customization, enabling clients to personalize branding elements and configurations.
duties: Participated in Smart Life Standard Edition business iterations, maintained household and family member management, device and room lists, device network provisioning, message center, etc.

Independently responsible for Smart Mobility Standard Edition business iterations, mainly involving BLE+X device control, geofencing, third-party map navigation, proximity-based auto-unlock, Siri controls, etc.
highlights: OEM development model, providing configuration files in the project to enable customers to configure via IoT platform and build applications on-demand, with code pruning support for unnecessary functionalities;
Supported multiple network provisioning methods including EZ (Wi-Fi Quick Connect), AP (Hotspot), NB-IoT, Bluetooth, QR code pairing;

Developed Thing Model SDK for physical entity digitization, abstracting device instances with "properties", "actions/events", and "services", enabling device control/status monitoring via standard MQTT protocol;
Supported extensive IoT protocols, Matter, Zigbee, BLE, Sigmesh, Beacon, Cat.1, etc.;
Initiated Tuya device compatibility with Home Assistant, enabling Tuya IoT device integration in Home Assistant ecosystems.

projects.name: DIDI Global Inc. (Passenger App)
projects.description: Didi is the world's leading mobility platform. The Passenger App serves as the core entry point for its primary business, delivering convenient and efficient transportation services to 550M+ users globally.
duties: Independently led feature iterations and maintenance for the Designated Driving service line, contributing to public platform component development.
Modularized scattered business logic across sub-components into standalone libraries, achieving business line autonomy and improving compilation speed by 30%.
Refactored codebase into layered architecture with core functionality libraries, enhancing cross-platform portability efficiency by 50%.
highlights: Architected unified ride-hailing platform using MVCS/MVVM patterns through template-driven scenarios, componentized features, and configurable business rules, consolidating premium/express/designated driving services.
Developed unified payment SDK with plugin-based management, enabling default implementations and custom plugin extensions for multi-platform compatibility.
Created ApolloSDK framework implementing gray release capabilities, AB testing frameworks, and rapid city deployment for new features.

Contributed to iterative feature development in the market data team, implementing stock price alerts, screenshot editing/sharing functionalities.
Optimized market sector lists by eliminating off-screen rendering issues, and refactored third-party sharing modules for better extensibility.
Established UI automation testing framework for regression testing, reducing production bugs by 40%. Developed mobile performance monitoring tools tracking metrics across versions.
